title: Tabata Kettlebell Swings
creator: Izumi Tabata (protocol); community variant
description: Eight rounds of 20 seconds of kettlebell swings, 10 seconds off. Russian (chest-height) swings with a bell you can keep swinging crisply for all eight rounds; 24 kg for men and 16 kg for women is the usual prescription. Score the lowest round, or the total.

source.title: Tabata regimen (High-intensity interval training, Wikipedia; original: Tabata et al. 1996)
